mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL above 207.0 and FEDFUNDS above 5.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that reduces real equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both CPIAUCSL exceeds 207.0 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1450.0 and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 112.0, it indicates a late-cycle expansion with overheating demand, causing the S&P 500 to underperform in the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1450.0 and INDPRO > 112.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5.25% in a single month, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 112.0 and a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) below 370000.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown and weak demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 112.0 and RSAFS < 370000.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0, it signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0.
